description: Audience-specific routes through the public Institute resource hub.

pathways.label: Newcomer
pathways.summary: Understand what the Institute is, watch an introduction, and join the public community.

pathways.label: Learner
pathways.summary: Start with the START docs, knowledge base, videos, courses, and textbook-oriented groups.

pathways.label: Researcher
pathways.summary: Move from conceptual references to ontology, metaanalysis, research records, and open questions.

pathways.label: Developer
pathways.summary: Find implementation repos, RxInfer work, GNN, pymdp, and project preparation surfaces.

pathways.label: Contributor
pathways.summary: Join activities, prepare a project, volunteer, or enter a structured program pathway.

pathways.label: Partner / Supporter
pathways.summary: Use partnership, support, donation, and fellowship pathways to help sustain public work.

pathways.label: Intern
pathways.summary: Develop a bounded contribution with structured support and a regular learning commitment.

pathways.label: Research fellow
pathways.summary: Review the research proposal, CV and recommendation requirements for sustained public work.

pathways.label: Symposium participant
pathways.summary: Register for the online Symposium, propose a presentation, or help organize the event.

pathways.label: Donor
pathways.summary: Support open education, research and community infrastructure through the Institute's public donation pathway.
